mapper.insert: INSERT INTO redirect_cache_invalidation_outbox ( tenant_id, domain_id, domain_scope, code, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{domainId}, #{domainScope}, #{code}, 'PENDING', 0, NULL, #{nextAttemptAtUtc}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, next_attempt_at = VALUES(next_attempt_at), processed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, domain_id, code, attempts FROM redirect_cache_invalidation_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{nowUtc} ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE redirect_cache_invalidation_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSED', processed_at = #{processedAtUtc}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE redirect_cache_invalidation_outbox SET attempts = #{attempts}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAtUtc}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
